ev.q: As of November 24, WHO and NREVSS collaborating laboratories in the United States tested 8,140 specimens for influenza viruses; 73 (0.9%) were positive.
the percentage of respiratory specimens testing positive for influenza viruses ranged from 0.4% to 1.7%
the percentage of patient visits for ILI was 1.4%, which is less than the national baseline of 1.9%
These percentages are low compared with the 24%--33% testing positive at the peak of the 1998--99, 1999--2000, and 2000--01 seasons.
This report summarizes influenza activity in the United States
In November, two virologically confirmed institutional outbreaks caused by influenza A viruses were reported to CDC.

methods_quotes.q: The national baseline was calculated as the mean percentage of visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks plus two standard deviations.
The epidemic threshold is 1.654 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
